# Glossary

- <a id="term-acceptance-criterion"></a>**Acceptance criterion**: A statement that a command, a test or an observation can show to be true or false. Each has an ID such as AC-1.
- <a id="term-completion-gate"></a>**Completion gate**: The rules that turn criteria, evidence and findings into one status: verified, partial, blocked, failed or research-only.
- <a id="term-coordinator"></a>**Coordinator**: The session that ran the command. It keeps the workflow record and takes the final status from the completion gate.
- <a id="term-evidence"></a>**Evidence**: The recorded result of one check: pass, fail, blocked or not-run, with the acceptance criteria it proves.
- <a id="term-finding"></a>**Finding**: A defect or gap that the adversarial review reports, with a severity, a confidence and evidence.
- <a id="term-fusion"></a>**Fusion**: A run in which two panel agents on their own models answer, criticise and revise, and a decider chooses the result.
- <a id="term-research-mode"></a>**Research mode**: The modes spec-audit and adversarial-research. They end in findings or a recommendation and report research-only.
- <a id="term-workflow"></a>**Workflow**: One task run through the phases intake, planning, execution, adversarial review, reconciliation and verification. A command such as /ultracode starts it.
- <a id="term-workflow-record"></a>**Workflow record**: The file .opencode/open-ultracode/state/workflow-state.json in the project root. It holds the goal, criteria, findings, evidence and completion report of one workflow.
